name: @package-broker/server
description: PACKAGE.broker - Minimalistic, SOC-2 Compatible Composer Mirror (Cloudflare Workers)

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/ui && npm run build -w packages/main && npm run build -w packages/cli && npm run build -w packages/cloudflare && npm run build -w packages/adapter-node
scripts.dev: cd packages/ui && npm run build && cd ../.. && npx wrangler dev -c wrangler.dev.toml --local --port 8787
scripts.db:migrate: npx wrangler d1 execute package-broker-db --local --file=./packages/main/migrations/0001_initial.sql -c wrangler.dev.toml
scripts.test:e2e:mocked: npm run db:migrate && TEST_MODE=mocked playwright test --project=mocked
